name: Novel Vocabulary LLM Fallback Routing
expected_behavior: Tier 1 detects low vocabulary coverage (33%). System seamlessly invokes Tier 2 (qwen2.5:3b LLM semantic fallback) and auto-routes to predictive_trend without asking the user to disambiguate.
key_talking_points: Lightweight TF-IDF classifier runs at sub-millisecond speeds for 60%+ of queries.
When novel wording is used, Tier 2 provides an LLM second opinion before ever bothering a human operator.
Zero disruption to the user experience.

name: True Disambiguation Last Resort
expected_behavior: Both Tier 1 and Tier 2 recognize that the prompt is genuinely underspecified. Tier 3 activates and displays 5 structured clickable options (Compliance Memo, Trend Forecast, Rule Check, Python Sandbox, Q&A).
key_talking_points: Disambiguation is a true safety last resort, not a failure mode for unfamiliar phrasing.
Operator gets clear, one-click intent selection.

name: Dual-Path Document OCR & Ingestion
prompt: show how trend degradation+memo with real numbers
expected_behavior: System checks text layer quality. If digital, extracts directly; if scanned, routes to qwen2.5vl:7b vision model. Extracts RMS vibration 5.4 mm/s and Bearing Temp 79.5°C.
key_talking_points: Avoids running heavy multimodal vision models on clean digital documents, saving VRAM.
Seamlessly falls back to vision OCR on degraded field scans.

name: Deterministic Safety Rule Engine (ISO 10816-3)
prompt: Evaluate ISO 10816-3 limits for PMP-204 vibration reading of 5.4 mm/s
expected_behavior: Rule Engine deterministically calculates delta: (5.4 - 4.5)/4.5 = +20.0% above limit. Classifies as Zone C (Unsatisfactory). Flags non-borderline (since > 10%), bypassing unnecessary ensemble loops.
key_talking_points: Deterministic mathematics: LLMs cannot hallucinate compliance or alter safety thresholds.
Accurate percentage proximity math protects against false borderline classifications.

name: Air-Gap Network Isolation & Zero Egress Verification
prompt: View live socket monitor and security telemetry
expected_behavior: Live OS socket scan shows 0 external connections. All traffic is bound strictly to localhost (127.0.0.1).
key_talking_points: 100% on-premises sovereignty: no data ever leaves the refinery perimeter.
Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chains guarantee audit trail immutability.
